effect: The two prepared parts joined into whole nerve cells, completing the goals. The final picture also shows chemical messengers crossing a gap to a neighboring cell.
reaction: The gap between the cells was a useful detail; I hadn't expected the final picture to show how a message reaches another cell.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because the panels showed an electrical change moving along the fibre without one ion traveling the whole distance.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the receiving branches was straightforward but less revealing than the channel explanation.

surprise.text: I was surprised that local movements of ions can pass a change along the fibre without a single particle traveling its whole length.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals made each pairing clear, although the pump shown in the channel result was not something I had built.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see more about how nerve cells pass messages to other cells; the final picture introduced that connection but didn't explain much about it.
